topic: Exhaust system, exhaust gas flow, constructional details and materials
syllabus_extract: Exhaust system, exhaust gas flow, constructional details and materials
specific_objectives: 13.1.2.2 Trainee will be able to explain function and operation of each components of gas turbine engine.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Examine engine cutaway model to identify exhaust nozzle, diffuser, and liner; verify safety precautions regarding hot surfaces and rotating parts; instructor supervises identification and material inspection.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the exhaust system?
Name two materials commonly used in exhaust liners.
How does exhaust gas flow direction change after the turbine?

development.content:
Exhaust gas flow path
Exhaust nozzle function
Thrust generation principle
Exhaust diffuser role
Pressure recovery mechanism

Exhaust liner construction
Heat resistant alloys
Cooling air circulation
Nozzle guide vanes
Material thermal properties

Exhaust system maintenance
Inspection criteria
Material degradation signs
Nozzle adjustment procedures
Safety during inspection

summary_questions: Explain how the exhaust nozzle converts pressure into thrust.
Describe the role of cooling air in exhaust liner construction.
List three signs of material degradation in the exhaust system.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the fuel system pressure control and flow control mechanisms to be discussed in LP 10.

pft_rows.syllabus: Fuel system, pressure control and flow control system, plunger types pump, gear type pump, various stages of fuel atomization and types of burners.
